name: rooftop
_provenance: Live-RTK venue from the 2026-06-04 field session. Pin headings MIGRATED to true compass bearing (the robot's convention). The battle-station UI had a heading mirror bug (stored 2*bearing - true_heading), so the operator's verbatim export (S1=133.6 / E1=312.6 — which rendered as arrows correctly facing each other) was the MIRROR of what reposition_node actually drives. Migrated via new = 2*42 - old: S1 133.6->310.4 (faces E1), E1 312.6->131.4 (faces S1). The UI mirror bug is now fixed (interactive.html drawPin + drag-inverse, 2026-06-04), so these true-compass values also render correctly on the map. PENDING on-robot verification before any autonomous run: place robot at S1, reposition, nudge a few cm -> nose must point toward E1. See ToDo 2026-06-04.
